coverage: Native archived one-day ATR rules on Binance perpetual records generated from hourly historical candles, including Binance index and funding records. ETH/USDT preserves the author's instrument. BTC/USDT is a separately identified port. Both samples start from a flat 10,000 USDT wallet and use the published maker/taker fees. Test windows are the project's Reference and Later samples and the ledger is observed near their ends.

launcher.state: Source writes two chart structures to in-memory _G; both writes are retained and never read for trading.

execution_model.funding: Apply observed rates to position exposure and hourly index opens, independently matching native settled cash within 0.001 USDT per market/window.
execution_model.sample_exit: Count each native exit order once across matched FIFO entries. All four scenarios finish with explicitly flat native accounts.
execution_model.snapshot: Stop strategy decisions one hour before the named window end to bound the simulated hourly clock; receipts record the actual observation time.
